name: Yagishita 2024 J-TAIL atezolizumab scenarios
description: Exact J-TAIL article/SI/FDA anchors plus fixed-effect, figure-derived EBE, and population ODE validation scenarios.

scenarios.name: J-TAIL article and supplement exact anchors
scenarios.description: Exact replay of model-relevant values extracted from article Tables 1-3, Figures 3, Supplemental Tables 1-6/Figure 2, and the public FDA PopPK review.

scenarios.name: Article Figure 1 public fixed-effect median
scenarios.description: Unchanged Stroh/FDA fixed effects at J-TAIL median covariates, with the two infusion timings inferred from the Figure 1 vector curve.

scenarios.name: Article Figure 1 exploratory median EBE
scenarios.description: Separately labeled effective median post-hoc random effects fitted to the digitized Figure 1A prediction median; not the original patient EBEs.

scenarios.name: 1200 mg q3w J-TAIL median-covariate exposure overlay
scenarios.description: Full ODE simulation of 1200 mg q3w IV atezolizumab using the Stroh fixed-effect two-compartment structure and J-TAIL median body weight, albumin, and tumor burden.
